title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
desc:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

 



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - MoneyLion
desc:
About Gen:

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.



Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.



About the Role

The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion. We pride ourselves on innovative initiatives and thrive in a fast paced and challenging environment. Join our multicultural team of visionaries and industry rebels in disrupting the traditional finance industry!

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who is technically proficient in programming to build machine learning systems and maintain high performing machine learning models in production. Designing machine learning systems requires that you, as the machine learning engineer, is able to frame business problems and design machine learning solutions that can effectively bring value to the company.  You will prototype, implement and experiment with machine learning methods to solve business use cases. You will lead efforts to automate, architect and optimise machine learning processes and workflows. You will also help define, execute and enforce best practices for test-driven model development processes for the entire Data Science team in MoneyLion.



Key Responsibilities

 - Able to frame and contextualize machine learning problems

 - Research, build and design machine learning systems and models that can solve business problems

 - Assess, understand and analyse data to select appropriate datasets for data modelling and testing

 - Identify, prototype and implement appropriate machine learning algorithms and tools to improve our products

 - Design, execute and monitor machine learning model experiments and metrics

 - Perform statistical analysis to evaluate and prove business impact of modelling improvements 

 - Automate, architect and orchestrate machine learning processes and pipelines

 - Monitor, optimise and maintain machine learning solutions in production

 - Enrich existing machine learning libraries and model development frameworks to empower model development in MoneyLion

 - Work with MLOps Engineers and Data Scientists to improve systems designs and architectures

 - Enforce test-driven development and advocate engineering best practices to reduce technical debt in machine learning systems

 - Develop tools and internal libraries to facilitate model governance over the machine learning development lifecycle
   
   

About You

 - Strong mathematical, statistical or actuarial background

 - Good programming knowledge and software engineering skills

 - Must have hands on experience in machine learning, predictive analytics and statistical modelling

 - Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production.

 - Adept at problem solving and troubleshooting using both textbook methods and novel viewpoints

 - Proficient in Python and SQL

 - Proficient with machine learning libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM

 - Preferably have experience in building machine learning systems and workflows

 - Preferably familiar and have experience with MLOps tools such as DVC, MLFlow, Metaflow, Seldon, BentoML

 - Preferably familiar and have experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes.

 - Solid communication and collaboration skills.
   
   

What's Next...

After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

 1. Online Technical Test

 2. Take-Home Assessment

 3. Interview & Discussion of Take-Home Assessment - Hiring Manager (Virtual or face-to-face)

title: Applied AI Engineer, People
desc: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date. Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara. About The Role: This role reports to the Head of Strategic Growth and can be full-time or contract. You’ll be the first engineer embedded in our People team, working directly with leadership and building agents that reach every corner of the company. As we scale, there’s real opportunity to work across functions and embed with other teams. Our goal is to build one of the first AI-native People Operations systems inside a scaling technology company. Instead of a large administrative HR organization, we’re building a small, high-leverage People team powered by smart systems, operational excellence, and AI-enabled processes we invent as we go. Our People team knows our Atomizers (that’s what we call our people) but lacks the technical skills to build systems that scale our people practices. You’ll be the person who turns our ideas into working tools, uncovers redundancy, gets more out of the platforms we already use, and builds AI proficiency across the team. This role is about efficiency, clear metrics, and leaving the team more capable than you found it. What You’ll Do: Build agents and automations. Ship agents and workflows across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding to benefits and People Operations. Shape our People tech stack. Connect Greenhouse, Metaview, Justworks, Slack, and Google Workspace, define how People data flows between them, and get the most from what we already use. Own People metrics and dashboards. Build clear, trusted views of hiring pipeline, time to fill, recruiter capacity, headcount, and organizational health so leaders can make decisions quickly. Find redundancy. Map how our team actually works, spot repeated manual steps and tool overlap, and fix them. Support a fast-scaling recruiting function. Help us keep up with a high volume of open roles without losing quality or candidate experience. Teach AI fluency. Run hands-on sessions, write simple playbooks and build templates so non-technical teammates can use Claude, ChatGPT and agents confidently. Keep exploring. Stay on top of new AI tools and practices, test them, and bring forward what's actually useful. Handle data responsibly. Treat employee and candidate data with the care and confidentiality it needs. What You Bring: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 1–2 years of experience, including internships or substantial projects, building AI agents or LLM-powered workflows that can scale across an organization. Strong proficiency with Claude Code, plus comfort with Python, SQL and APIs. Experience building dashboards or reporting from messy data. A track record of building efficient, repeatable practices that scale, not one-off scripts. The ability to explain technical ideas in plain language to non-engineers, and patience teaching them. Curiosity about how teams work, and a habit of asking "why do we do it this way?" Good judgment about privacy and handling sensitive information. Nice to Have: Familiarity with both Claude and ChatGPT ecosystems, including MCP connectors, custom GPTs or Projects. Experience with workflow tools or BI platforms. Interest in people operations, talent, or organizational design. Why Join: You'll build agents that reach every team in the company, with real ownership from day one. Your work will shape how a fast-growing deep-tech company hires and supports its people. You'll have the space to experiment with the newest AI tools and see your impact right away. The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits. Salary Range $110,000 — $150,000 USD Atomic Machines

title: Applied Scientist - Research Engineer (Tabular Data), EMEA

desc:

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE ROLE

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on tabular data. You will design, train, and deploy SOTA models that understand, query, and reason over structured data, and apply them to diverse use cases.

Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

 - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

 - Generate and curate datasets of tables, spreadsheets and databases, and build evaluators and benchmarks for table understanding, text-to-SQL, and prediction on tabular data.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases.

 - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

 - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

 - Experience training or fine-tuning large language models, or tabular foundation models (e.g. TabPFN).

 - Strong background in machine learning on tabular data, including classical baselines (e.g. gradient boosting), and comfortable with SQL, pandas, and messy real-world data.

 - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.

 - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

 - Ex-founder or builder

 - Experience with text-to-SQL, table question answering, or spreadsheet agents.

 - Experience with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards (e.g. query execution).

 - Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale.

 - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.

 - Publications in top academic journals or conferences.

 - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines.

title: Quantitative Model Validator, NLP and Gen AI/ Agentic AI

title: Data Scientist
desc: We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Global Risk and Compliance team at MGS. In this role, you are expected to partner with global audit teams to develop data-driven solutions that enhance audit activities and provide meaningful insights across various business functions. You will leverage data analytics, programming, automation, and machine learning techniques to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities while helping strengthen the use of analytics across Audit Services. Position Responsibilities: Collaborate with cross-functional audit teams to develop analytics-enabled solutions, including data validation, consolidation, cleansing, and quality assessment. Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, outliers, and potential compliance or control indicators. Develop and maintain business, system, and data knowledge across supported areas while documenting insights to strengthen the team’s analytics knowledge base. Communicate analytical findings and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and visualizations for audit management and business partners. Support the adoption of data analytics across Audit Services by providing technical guidance and training and automating processes to improve data availability and audit efficiency. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related discipline. Advanced studies or a Master’s degree would be an advantage. Hands-on experience in data analytics, data management, programming, machine learning, data mining, and statistical analysis. Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience working with Microsoft Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Experience gathering, storing, retrieving, and analyzing data across various platforms, including structured and unstructured datasets. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building machine learning models and applying statistical techniques such as regression, clustering, and decision trees. Hands-on experience or familiarity with Generative AI, text analytics, and open-source data visualization libraries. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, VBA, and Power Apps. Previous experience within the Insurance or Financial Services industry, with an interest in developing strong business and audit knowledge. Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, adapt to change, and translate complex analysis into user-friendly insights. When you join our team: We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want. We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words. As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see. About Manulife and John Hancock Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html . Manulife

title: Data Analytics Engineer
desc: Overview of the Role: Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. The Data Analytics Engineer is a hands-on technical role within the Data Analytics team, responsible for designing, building, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data transformation frameworks, and analytics solutions across distributed cloud and enterprise big data platforms. This position combines core data engineering expertise in Python, PySpark, Snowflake, Databricks, and Hadoop with a modern engineering mindset that leverages AI Coding Agents and developer tools to accelerate delivery and maintain high code quality. The role requires close collaboration with business analysts, data scientists, and functional stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into resilient, high-performance data products. Candidates should bring 2+ years of progressive experience in data engineering or big data analytics, along with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. This opportunity offers exposure to large-scale legacy-to-cloud data migration efforts alongside the adoption of next-generation, AI-augmented engineering practices. Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain robust, end-to-end data pipelines for batch and real-time processing using Python, PySpark, Databricks, and Snowflake. Manage, migrate, and optimize legacy datasets and workloads across enterprise Hadoop ecosystems to modern cloud data platforms. Optimize pipeline performance, query execution times, resource allocation, and storage costs across distributed environments. Partner with business analysts, data scientists, and functional stakeholders to understand requirements and formulate analytical approaches. Deliver actionable insights that address complex business challenges. Apply structured root-cause analysis and analytical problem-solving techniques to diagnose data anomalies, pipeline bottlenecks, and complex logic issues. Create automated data validation, reconciliation, and quality monitoring frameworks to ensure high data integrity and compliance. Actively incorporate next-generation AI Coding Agents and developer assistants, such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor, into daily development, code reviews, automated unit testing, and technical documentation workflows. Drive engineering productivity by adopting best practices in automated refactoring, rapid prototyping, and AI-augmented debugging. Stay current with emerging tools, data architecture, and AI-enabled data engineering methodologies. Follow disciplined CI/CD release practices, Git-based version control, code quality gates, and automated test coverage. Ensure all data pipelines and storage solutions comply with enterprise data governance, data lineage, information security, and regulatory standards. Author comprehensive technical design documents, data dictionary definitions, and operational runbooks. Qualifications: 2+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, Big Data Analytics, or a related technical role. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Technology, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced proficiency in Python, including Pandas, PySpark, and NumPy. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and modular design. Strong hands-on experience developing large-scale distributed data transformations in PySpark and Databricks. Proven expertise in Snowflake architecture and SnowSQL. Hands-on experience with data loading and unloading using Snowpipe, Tasks, and Streams, as well as clustering and query profiling. Solid understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, including HDFS, Hive, MapReduce, and YARN. Experience migrating and integrating Hadoop workloads with modern cloud architectures. Expert-level SQL skills for complex querying, window functions, and dimensional and relational data modeling. Practical knowledge and working experience using AI Coding Agents and assistants, such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor, to boost engineering velocity and code reliability. Proven ability to break down complex analytical problems, design scalable technical solutions, and communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders. Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools, such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows, is preferred. Experience with CI/CD tools, such as Git, Jenkins, Tekton, or Harness, is preferred. Familiarity with containerization basics, such as Docker, is also preferred. Exposure to financial services, banking domain data, or risk and compliance data platforms is preferred. Familiarity with DataOps, test-driven development, and automated data quality frameworks, such as Great Expectations, is preferred. title: Data Engineer / AI Engineer
desc: Job Title: Data Engineer / AI Engineer Location: Bracknell, minimum of 3 days in office Role Overview As a Data Engineer / AI Engineer in the Operational Analytics team, you will be the hands-on builder who designs, develops, and maintains our data infrastructure from the ground up — ahead of full IT handover. This is not a Database Administrator role. We need someone who has built things from scratch, is comfortable operating in ambiguity, and is excited to shape both the engineering and AI layer of a growing analytics function. What You'll Be Doing Write clean, well-documented Python and SQL code with a focus on performance, maintainability, and reusability. Architect and develop data models within our centralized data platform, ensuring data quality, consistency, and traceability. Build new data assets from raw sources, bridging operational systems and the analytical layer until IT takes full ownership. Develop and implement AI/ML-enabled data features — including data enrichment, anomaly detection, and predictive pipelines. Integrate AI APIs and LLM-based tools into data workflows to accelerate analytics at scale. Work closely with analysts and business stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into robust engineering solutions. Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve data across the organization. Support the transition of built solutions to IT once production-ready, ensuring proper documentation and handover. What You'll Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, strong managing large datasets and fluent with SQL querying, including building ETL/ELT pipelines and data models from scratch. Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, PySpark, or similar) and SQL. Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure DL, AWS S3, Databricks). Practical knowledge of AI/ML concepts and experience integrating AI capabilities into data products or pipelines. Excellent communication skills: able to engage with business stakeholders and translate requirements into technical designs. Comfortable working as a builder and owner before IT infrastructure is fully in place — a 'zero-to-one' mindset. Nice to Have Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Azure Data Factory. Exposure to LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI).Experience with version control (Git/GitHub) and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
